## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)
*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and SuttaCentral data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*
The *Dosapariññā Sutta* (Iti 10; PTS It 5) is a discourse found in the first section of the *Itivuttaka* in the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. The central teaching of the text concerns the complete understanding (*pariññā*) and relinquishment of hate or aversion (*dosa*): when the mind is cleansed of passion for aversion and abandons it, one is capable of putting an end to suffering [SuttaCentral].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
